learning_outcomes.text: classify polymeric materials and their properties in relation to other materials.
distinguish between different manufacturing processes in plastics processing.
select the appropriate manufacturing process for a plastic component.
assign components to the corresponding manufacturing process based on their geometry.
apply the contents and concepts taught here in other disciplines in a solution-oriented manner.

syllabus_topics: Fundamental structure and properties of polymeric materials
Classification of polymeric materials and their properties in relation to other materials
Execution of tests for quality control of plastics
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded based on a successful written exam. Active participation in the practical work is a prerequisite for taking the exam.
